verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. An in-app terminal editor with syntax or lint checking falls outside that product category. Tailscale SSH and remote coding environments only connect users to their own machines, where any editing happens in external tools. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale ships an editor or linter of its own.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app
